svg.text: Park City overview: 1,000 x 1,000 studs, 12 spawns, eat inwards
x -510 to 510, z -510 to 510 (z south is down). 1 grid square = 100 studs.

Scenes: thin outline, the thick edge is the FRONT (small things spill to the front, the big thing stands at the back). Dots: objects at their real bulk, coloured by tier. Dashed lines: trails. Data: docs/design/maps/park-city-layout.json
